name: triage_then_save_as_playbook
why: The P4 promise on one row: the agent investigates a real alert, then
the analyst says 'save that as a playbook', and the offer that comes
back must be TRACE-BUILT -- its wiring derived from the observed tool
outputs the triage recorded, not guessed. This is the triage-close
offer path (emit_playbook_offer with NO yaml arg), which until N2 had
zero graded coverage: no scenario drove the triage-close offer, and no
grader asserted the offer's draft was trace-built (ops_summary with
verified badges) rather than hand-authored (emit_playbook_offer
(yaml=<authored>)).
Three turns is the minimum arc: (1) triage populates the SkillTrace
with real run_op observed_outputs; (2) the analyst's 'save that as a
playbook' ask stays in TRIAGE intent -- the triage prompt says to
call emit_playbook_offer with NO yaml arg, and the card's ops_summary
is compiled from the recorded trace by the deterministic skill
compiler; (3) accept compiles + pushes deterministically.
Staying in triage (NOT flipping to build) is deliberate: the triage
prompt unambiguously routes a save request to emit_playbook_offer (no
yaml), while the build prompt's triage->build handoff section expects
an 'Operations used during triage' directive the analyst did not
send. Flipping to build lets the model hand-author YAML instead of
using the trace -- the exact P4 defect wiring_derives_from_observed
catches. The triage-close offer is the path the widget uses when an
analyst says 'save that' mid-investigation; the build-from-triage CTA
is a different flow.
wiring_derives_from_observed is the load-bearing grader: it fails if
no offer was emitted, fails if the offer was hand-authored (no
verified badges -- the wiring is the model's guess), and fails if
any step has verified=false (its inputs fell back to a manual gap).
All-verified is the 'bottle the moment of genius' assertion -- the
playbook will re-run deterministically on a fresh record because
every step's inputs trace to an earlier observed output, not a
literal the model invented. yaml_compiles is deliberately absent:
the trace-built path surfaces ops_summary (verified badges) not YAML
text, and the verified badges already imply a successful
compile_and_verify. tools_are_real + no_unserved_reads +
no_excessive_fan_out guard the triage turn itself: no invented
tools, no unanswered cassette reads (the investigation was real, not
a fallback to the mounted entity), no get_record fan-out.
offer_accept_compiles grades the Accept (step 3), the step that saves.
Without it this row passed 2/2 while every accept answered 'Could not
save playbook'. The push itself needs a box; offline grades the compile.
